subject: ONE round tawny female owl in tiny reading glasses and a knitted shawl, huge amber eyes, never held in one pose
second_characters: TWO couriers in green caps flying round her in a ring with the goods in EVERY beat

props.big: ONE glowing tablet with a plain blue screen; ONE roaring whirl of goods circling the owl
props.small: TEN identical white kettles; A SWARM of multicoloured goods: red sneakers, yellow rubber ducks, pink pillows, green blenders, blue umbrellas

environment: a cosy cluttered flat at noon, shelves, plants, no empty wall
lighting: bright warm noon sunlight flooding the room
motion_rule: the frame is TALL and the owl fills two thirds of its height till 7.70, her face never under a quarter of it, her wings and feet in shot. From the very first frame a whirl of multicoloured goods and the two couriers spin round her in a tight ring in EVERY beat, sweeping across the lower frame, never over her face, speech beats too. The camera sways close, never parks, new shot size every beat. ONE big hero action per beat.

audio.delivery: dry low female voice, matter-of-fact, biting off each word
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, every line said once, last word by 5.60, then the whirl carries it
audio.lip_sync: the owl herself speaks, beak opening on every syllable, brows and eyes alive
audio.pronunciation: RAN-she DU-ma-la, chem BOL-she VY-bor, tem LUCH-she. te-PER ZNA-yu, E-to PUT k HA-o-su

timeline.a: waist-up, low angle, from the very first frame goods and a courier whirl round her, she turns with the ring, the glowing tablet in one wing, her head swivels a half-turn after TEN kettles, a red sneaker whips under her beak, beak working
low angle, full body, beak working, she jabs the tablet with one wing tip and the whirl speeds up, a courier flying round her across the lens
a courier slams a parcel into her chest, she reels and flaps, pink pillows whipping across the lens
side-on, beak working, she kicks goods off her heap into the ring, a yellow duck flying across the lens by her face
full body, beak working, she swats a blue umbrella away with one wing, goods tearing across the lens
low angle, she leaps up and rips a parcel apart mid-air with her talons, foam peanuts erupting into the whirl
goods pile up to her chest, she flaps hard to stay on top, a courier flying round her across the lens
she tears open ONE parcel with her beak and pulls out an eleventh identical white kettle, sun flashing off it, the TEN kettles circling her
she hurls the kettle into the whirl and the goods bury her up to her neck, a green blender raking across the lens
only her head pokes out of the heap, it swivels round after the whirl, goods and couriers circling her head
her head swivels back to the lens, a flat stare, she blinks once, a last parcel bouncing off her head

must_appear: 0.00 multicoloured goods and couriers whirling round the owl; 7.00 the eleventh identical kettle; 9.20 only her head above the heap, flat stare at the lens
negative_prompt: printed text, cyrillic words, digits, logos, subtitles, watermark, a horizontal 16:9 picture, letterbox, a hero running at the camera on her feet, a parked camera, a head-on medium shot, a still or empty background, wide shot, a small distant hero, night, a hero back to the camera, a closed beak while speaking, offscreen narration, a motionless first or last second, a line said twice, speech after 5.60, English speech, foreign accent, a male voice, a second owl, goods covering her face or beak
